observations: Photo 0 is a professional studio product image with a white background and reflections.
Two yellow wheel lock clamps with red claw covers and handles are shown.
The text 'Wheel lock' is printed on a black label on the side of the devices.
A watermark 'HIPHEN SOLUTIONS SERVICES' is visible across the center of the image.
One device has a key inserted into the lock cylinder.
The image appears to be a stock photo from a commercial catalog rather than a photo of a second-hand item.

claims.evidence: Material strength and weight cannot be determined from a stock photo.
This is a subjective marketing claim.
Requires physical testing on a vehicle wheel to verify fit and function.

risks.risk: The seller may not possess the item as they are using a watermarked stock photo.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual item in a real-world setting (e.g., on a floor or table) with a handwritten note of the current date.

risks.risk: The lock mechanism may be seized or keys may be missing.
risks.proof: A video showing the key unlocking the device and the clamp arms moving freely.

risks.risk: The actual item may be a different size or lower quality than the one in the stock photo.
risks.proof: Photos of the actual item showing its scale and build quality.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual item you have in your possession, not a stock image.
Photo showing all keys included in the sale.
A short video showing the lock and sliding mechanism working.
response.reason: The seller has provided a watermarked stock photo instead of a photo of the actual item. It is impossible to verify the condition, authenticity, or even the existence of the goods from this image.
